base: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE isolated small fantasy strategy game difficulty badge icon. This is a production-ready 2D RGBA game UI asset, not a complete interface or icon sheet. Same clean hand-painted style as the reference mobile game: crisp dark outlines, broad simple readable shapes, restrained golden metal highlights, soft upper-left light. Subject is a small vertically hanging heraldic swallow-tail pennant on a short horizontal metal rod, with a simple chevron rank emblem in the center. Front orthographic view, symmetrical and level, complete silhouette, no perspective. Tight square canvas, 10 percent transparent safety margin, genuine transparent background everywhere outside the badge. Keep the exact same overall proportions across difficulty and state variants. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no stars, no circle background, no extra icon, no surrounding UI, no scenery, no floor, no checkerboard, no heavy drop shadow. Must read clearly at 42 pixels high.

difficulty.detail: NORMAL difficulty: warm bronze and ochre pennant with a single clear pale gold upward chevron. Plain short rod and modest bronze cap, no horns. Approachable first rank.

ELITE difficulty: sapphire blue pennant, brushed silver rod and trim with small gold details, two stacked pale gold upward chevrons. A slightly stronger angular top cap than normal. Distinctly second rank.

HELL difficulty: deep crimson-red pennant, blackened metal rod with small outward-curving dark horn tips at its ends and restrained gold edges, three stacked pale gold upward chevrons. Distinctly strongest rank, readable and compact, no skull illustration.

states.detail: UNSELECTED state: clear original difficulty colors, muted metal rim, modest matte highlights.

SELECTED state: retain the difficulty color and chevron count exactly, brighten the outer metal rim with warm gold edge light and stronger clean highlights. No glow extending beyond the icon, no extra outer plate or frame.

LOCKED state: retain the same difficulty silhouette and exact chevron count, but render the whole pennant and metal in desaturated stone-gray and gray-brown with subdued contrast. No padlock symbol: the game will overlay its own live lock if needed.
